story: Dogs are sensitive to small variations of the Earth's magnetic field
text: I remember seeing a show remarking on similar sensitivity being observed in foxes when hunting mice in the snow. Apparently, the fox is much more accurate when diving when facing north. [VIDEO]

story: Dogs poop in alignment with Earth’s magnetic field, study finds (2014)
text: > any plausible reason for a non-migrating animal to align with the magnetic field, when defecating or at any other time. Snow foxes seem to hunt better when oriented in direction of the magnetic north. [LINK] [VIDEO]

story: Why do dogs tilt their heads? New study offers clues
text: Watch [1] @ 1:08. Is it really a mystery as to why canines tilt their heads when spoken to? It's always seemed self-evident that they are hearing a sound that is of interest and they are evaluating to see if it's useful information. 1. [VIDEO]
